item.title: Folk Emerging
item.description:
Title: Folk Emerging
Genre: Indie , RPG , Simulation , Strategy
Developer: Curious Dynamics
Publisher: Curious Dynamics
Franchise: Turn-Biased Indies
Release Date: Aug 26, 2026




About This Game

Lead nomadic families through the Stone Age in this turn-based 4X strategy game with deeply simulated characters, cultures, and ecosystems. Explore the vast wilderness, gather and trade scarce resources, and stand your ground in risky autobattler combat. Discover fire, domestication, politics—and survive to tell the tale.

Experience what prehistoric life was like by diving into this exploration of ecology, paleolithic societies, and the origins of culture.

Before agriculture and settlements, we spent hundreds of thousands of years as nomadic hunter-gatherers. Guide your people as you migrate through harsh climates, each posing unique challenges.

Manage the relationships between individuals, families, and tribes. Watch your collective adapt over countless generations. Beware the unintended consequences current choices can have on your great-great-great-grandchildren.

Optimize your strategy before each autobattler skirmish, because a warrior is not just a warrior. When one falls in combat, the tribe loses not only a fighter but also a skilled hunter, family member, and carrier of hard-won wisdom passed down through the ages.

Hunt, gather, and extract resources from the ecosystems around you, but tread carefully: nature is ruthless and you are at its mercy. Maintain the natural equilibrium or face sudden and unexpected challenges.

Features

  • Technology: a tech tree spanning the Pleistocene up to the start of the Bronze Age, covering skills from controlled fire and cooking, through domestication and agriculture, all the way to megalithic construction and the first cities.

  • Culture: shape your tribe’s unique culture, with evolving cultural norms that differentiate you from your neighbors, affecting trade and war.

  • Economy: resources are finite and their extraction affects the environment.

  • Ecology: 9 unique climates, each with a complex and dynamic food web.

  • Procedurally generated Earth-like maps based on realistic climate simulations.

  • Many generations of deeply simulated individuals with heritable traits, all affecting various game systems.

  • Narrative events that can alter the trajectory of your entire tribe.

  • Social Networks: Dynamic social network visualization, enabling a new way to understand and manage family trees and relationships between members of your band.

  • Diplomacy: trade, fight, or collaborate with other tribes.

Descrierea conținutului pentru adulți indisponibilă.

System Requirements

Windows

    Minimum:
    • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
    • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
    • Processor: Intel® Core™ i5, or equivalent
    • Memory: 8 GB RAM
    • Graphics: NVIDIA® GeForce® GTX 750 Ti (2GB), or AMD® Radeon™ R7 370 (2GB), or equivalent
    • DirectX: Version 11
    • Storage: 2 GB available space
    Recommended:
    • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
    • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
    • Processor: Intel® Core™ i7, or equivalent
    • Memory: 16 GB RAM
    • Graphics: NVIDIA® GeForce® GTX 970 (4GB), or AMD® Radeon™ RX 570 (4GB), or equivalent
    • DirectX: Version 11
    • Storage: 4 GB available space
    • Additional Notes: SSD recommended, particularly for larger and later-game saves.

item.title: Sniper Camouflage Orange Spy Warrior I Buried Two Bodies in the Garden and the Police Haven't Figured Out Yet That They're Missing Because They Were a Lonely Old Couple Who Had No Relatives Simulator 2026
item.description:
Title: Sniper Camouflage Orange Spy Warrior I Buried Two Bodies in the Garden and the Police Haven't Figured Out Yet That They're Missing Because They Were a Lonely Old Couple Who Had No Relatives Simulator 2026
Genre: Action , Adventure , Casual , Indie , Simulation , Early Access
Developer: The Only Way Out
Publisher: The Only Way Out
Franchise: The Only Way Out
Release Date: Aug 26, 2026
Early Access Release Date: Aug 26, 2026




About This Game

Warning: This game is not intended for people with photosensitive epilepsy.

Sniper Camouflage Orange Spy Warrior I Buried Two Bodies in the Garden and the Police Haven't Figured Out Yet That They're Missing Because They Were a Lonely Old Couple Who Had No Relatives Simulator 2026

Abbreviated as SCOSWIBTBITGATPHFOYTTMBTWALOCWHNRS2026, or simply Sniper Simulator 2026, or it could also be LSD: Sniper Simulator. IIt's a unique sandbox sniper simulator that blends first-person point-and-click with immersive physics-based object manipulation.

The game features various side activities and a world full of hidden secrets. Your main task is to kill the designated targets, isn't it? But it won't be easy.

Even though the targets aren't particularly dangerous, your main enemies as a sniper are gravity (bullet drop) and wind (sidewind) , just like a sniper in real life, requiring you to carefully interact with your environment and equipment to pull off the perfect shot.

Sniper gameplay (Windage and Elevation)

One day I was playing Sniper Ghost Warrior 3 and realized the game was way too easy. It occurred to me to make it a little more autistic and retarded, Instead of the bullet flying in the direction the scope is pointing, you have to adjust the scope yourself based on the wind and the distance to the target. SGW shows you the distance and actively displays the crosswind, but my game doesn't do that, you have to figure it out yourself the old-fashioned way, just like snipers do in real life (it's definitely not a 1:1 match).

Simply put, the scope doesn't tell you where the bullet will land, and you don't change the bullet's range in any way during the game. On the contrary, thanks to the scope settings, it tells you the exact direction of the bullet's impact if the target is at the distance you've set, and the same goes for crosswinds.

Windage is a correction for the wind's drift

Elevation is the correction for a bullet's trajectory based on distance

Customize your sniper spot as your home base

In the game, you can only shoot from certain sniper spots. Since they’re all the same, you can upgrade your sniper spot with decorations and other cool features, including some bonuses. Examples:

  • A radio that plays your music from a folder

  • A cell phone that can play videos

  • A drawing board where you can draw anything

  • A slot machine or other items that let you gamble or get ammo in addition to what’s in the game world

  • Then there are decorations that give you bonuses, like a playground that confuses snipers for a longer period of time

Side Activities

In addition to the main quests in the game, there are also a number of side activities, such as:

  • time trials, cargo races, and stunts

  • time-based parkour

  • boat races

  • climbing

  • special levels, such as one with a sniper spot mounted on a car (see the gameplay video)

Key elements:

  • hand interaction, game requires magazine change bolt movement with mouse etc..

  • Unique graphics and styling

  • side quests and secrets outside the main quest

  • Editor (not yet)

  • Realistic ballistics: distance, wind drift, and manual scope calibration.

item.title: Fell & Sell
item.description:
Title: Fell & Sell
Genre: Action , RPG , Simulation
Developer: Art Games Studio S.A.
Publisher: Art Games Studio S.A. , PlayWay S.A.
Franchise: AGSFranchise , PlayWay S.A.
Release Date: Aug 26, 2026




About This Game

Why buy from heroes when you can be one?

Be the ultimate shopkeeper in a gorgeous, stylized fantasy world— but getting your stock means getting your hands dirty.
Step into a fast-paced 3D first-person hack'n'slash roguelike shopkeeper where your business success relies just as much on how hard you can swing a sword and how fast you can run as your trading skills.
Your inventory costs blood, sweat, and steel.

If you are reading this, you haven’t been slaughtered by a skeleton (yet?)—congratulations!

Study these sacred tenets to survive the dungeon depths, forge shop fixtures, and ruthlessly price your way to the top.

Step through the doors behind your shop into a descending roguelike nightmare, or head to the local forest to forage.

  • The Dungeon Demands a Toll: Carve your way through hordes of skeletons and monstrous foes. The deeper you go, the rarer the loot. But beware: if you die, you lose your entire unbanked haul .
    Do you secure the bag and head home, or risk it all for a legendary drop?

  • Crazy Build Potential: Find dungeon altars to alter your playstyle radically. Shrink down to a tiny size to dodge massive attacks, use the Midas Touch to melt heavy items into gold, or cycle through manic and depressed combat states to keep enemies guessing!

  • Survive the Living Forest: Nature has a mind of its own. Adapt on the fly to goblin raiding parties, sudden thunderstorms, and the mind-bending chaos of psychedelic mushroom season.

Surviving the wilds is only half the job. Once you make it back to your cabin in one piece, it's time to put your hard-earned materials and recipes to work.

  • Gear Up: Forge stronger weapons and craft tougher armor so you can push even deeper into the dungeon on your next run.

  • Check the Quest Board: Survived expedition? Make sure you stop by the local Quest Board to turn feats you've achieved during your expedition into gold, gear, and items.

  • Decorate (for Combat): Build specialized decor to customize your space. Your interior design isn't just cosmetic; the right furniture layout provides permanent combat buffs for your next dive and boosts your shop's overall sales appeal.

Unlock the front doors and let the gold flow.

  • Ruthless Economics: You control the tags. Read the market to set prices based on current supply, demand, your shop’s prestige, and your decoration bonuses.
    Find the sweet spot—price too high and goods gather dust; price too low, and you go bankrupt.

  • Grow Your Business: Take your massive profits and reinvest. Transform your humble roadside cabin into the ultimate mercantile powerhouse.

    • Memory: 16 GB RAM
    • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 970 or equivalent
    • Storage: 4 GB available space
    • Sound Card: DirectX compatible

item.title: Night Rolls Cozy Store
item.description:
Title: Night Rolls Cozy Store
Genre: Casual , Indie , Simulation
Developer: Polytale Games
Publisher: Polytale Games
Release Date: Aug 26, 2026




About This Game

🌙 The city sleeps. Your store doesn't.


In Night Rolls: Cozy Store , you run a small convenience store from 11 PM to 6 AM.

Order products, fill the shelves, make fresh sushi, and serve the people who wander in during the night.

There are no game overs or stressful timers. Take your time, put on the radio, and run the store your way.

🍣 Make fresh sushi


Head into the kitchen and prepare sushi, nigiri, and maki by hand.

• Pick a recipe from your cookbook
• Place each ingredient yourself
• Unlock more recipes as you play
• Sell your dishes before they expire

Fresh food takes a little more work, but it can also bring in more money.

📦 Keep the shelves full


Use the store computer to order drinks, snacks, groceries, and other useful items.

Your order is delivered outside by drone. Bring it in, unpack it, and find some room on the shelves.

• Order stock from your supplier
• Restock empty shelves
• Unlock new and exclusive products
• Make sure customers can find what they want

💴 Watch your money


You still have rent, bills, stock, and ingredients to pay for.

Change your prices, keep an eye on what is trending, and try to make a little more money each night.

• Set your own prices
• Follow trending products
• Check your sales and expenses
• Save enough to buy the store for yourself

There is no bankruptcy screen waiting to punish you. A bad night just means you may need a better plan for the next one.

⭐ Read your customer reviews


Customers can leave reviews after visiting the store.

They notice if they found what they wanted, if the floor was clean, and if there was enough choice on the shelves.

• Read new reviews on the store computer
• Build your reputation
• Learn what customers liked or couldn't find
• Unlock more products as your reputation grows

🏪 Make the place yours


You can change the colors of the store and kitchen, customize your character, and choose what to listen to during the shift.

You can also read local posts, watch the street outside, and pet the cat when things are quiet.

🌃 See you at 11 PM

Title: Night Rolls Cozy Store
Genre: Casual , Indie , Simulation
Developer: Polytale Games
Publisher: Polytale Games
Release Date: Aug 26, 2026




About This Game

🌙 The city sleeps. Your store doesn't.


In Night Rolls: Cozy Store , you run a small convenience store from 11 PM to 6 AM.

Order products, fill the shelves, make fresh sushi, and serve the people who wander in during the night.

There are no game overs or stressful timers. Take your time, put on the radio, and run the store your way.

🍣 Make fresh sushi


Head into the kitchen and prepare sushi, nigiri, and maki by hand.

• Pick a recipe from your cookbook
• Place each ingredient yourself
• Unlock more recipes as you play
• Sell your dishes before they expire

Fresh food takes a little more work, but it can also bring in more money.

📦 Keep the shelves full


Use the store computer to order drinks, snacks, groceries, and other useful items.

Your order is delivered outside by drone. Bring it in, unpack it, and find some room on the shelves.

• Order stock from your supplier
• Restock empty shelves
• Unlock new and exclusive products
• Make sure customers can find what they want

💴 Watch your money


You still have rent, bills, stock, and ingredients to pay for.

Change your prices, keep an eye on what is trending, and try to make a little more money each night.

• Set your own prices
• Follow trending products
• Check your sales and expenses
• Save enough to buy the store for yourself

There is no bankruptcy screen waiting to punish you. A bad night just means you may need a better plan for the next one.

⭐ Read your customer reviews


Customers can leave reviews after visiting the store.

They notice if they found what they wanted, if the floor was clean, and if there was enough choice on the shelves.

• Read new reviews on the store computer
• Build your reputation
• Learn what customers liked or couldn't find
• Unlock more products as your reputation grows

🏪 Make the place yours


You can change the colors of the store and kitchen, customize your character, and choose what to listen to during the shift.

You can also read local posts, watch the street outside, and pet the cat when things are quiet.
